parsed.rationale: All five participating records are type-alias-objects with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural pipeline matched them on shape alone (both `shared_field_count: 2` and `jaccard: null` confirm there are no substantive shared fields to consolidate). The aliases serve distinct domain roles: `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` are Discogs API response aliases inside `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift`, while `Release` and `Artist` in `Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift` and `_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift` are Metadata-layer domain aliases. Merging them would conflate an external API mapping concern (Artwork package) with an internal domain model concern (Metadata package), introducing an inappropriate cross-package coupling. The coincidence is purely structural — empty type-alias bodies — not a sign of duplicated logic.
